name: Work App
description: A work app your team opens like team chat — the AI does the bookkeeping with your project sheets, you answer and confirm.
explanation:
Start / App → AI (gpt-6-sol, image input, Work app tool) → End.

Deploy it, then open the app from the Start node ("Open app") — the address works like team chat (owner and invited members).
On first open an empty project is created. The AI asks what work it is and suggests an app template (e.g. Swiss VAT); a person presses Apply.
The server adds the app template guide, the project notes and a sheet summary to the AI instructions on every turn.
Only Start / App, AI, End and the Work app tool are allowed — other nodes or tools block the chat.
